name: Saved search emails / Define search and notification identities

intent.outcome: Let book shoppers save search terms and receive a daily email about matching new listings.
intent.users: Callers, state owners and operators named by the problem.
intent.constraints: Make ordering, durability, capacity and retry assumptions explicit. Finite new listings and exact lowercase title-token matching against already saved searches. One matching station scans bounded terms; no inverted index, retroactive search, unsubscribe, SMTP, external scheduler or real provider. Days 1 and 2 are explicit synthetic clock tokens, not wall-clock days. Simulated mailbox idempotency is a required endpoint contract and does not prove exactly-once real email. Every stage is evolution Stage 1 simulation, independent of diagram detail levels.
intent.success: An observable request path, bounded waiting, visible failures and a justified recovery policy.
